name: r2-cyclist-indian
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY; app.cameraSystem.cinema = null; app.selectMode('cyclist'); app.teleportTo(-5566.5, -2955, 0); const e = app.controllerManager.getActiveEntity(); const t0 = performance.now(); let last = -1, maxDy = 0, py = null, minY = 1e9, maxY = -1e9; const id = setInterval(() => { const t = (performance.now() - t0) / 1000; if (py !== null) maxDy = Math.max(maxDy, Math.abs(e.position.y - py)); py = e.position.y; minY = Math.min(minY, e.position.y); maxY = Math.max(maxY, e.position.y); if (Math.floor(t * 2) !== last) { last = Math.floor(t * 2); console.log('[ride] r2-cyclist-indian t ' + t.toFixed(1) + ' x ' + e.position.x.toFixed(1) + ' z ' + e.position.z.toFixed(1) + ' y ' + e.position.y.toFixed(2) + ' overCut ' + C.subwayCutAt(e.position.x, e.position.z) + ' v ' + (e.speed || 0).toFixed(1) + ' maxStep ' + maxDy.toFixed(3) + ' yRange ' + minY.toFixed(2) + '..' + maxY.toFixed(2)); } if (t > 8.5) clearInterval(id); }, 50); })()
